items.title: Brakes
items.body: Brakes are the one system you can't afford to guess about. We inspect, repair and replace brake parts so your car stops the way it should.

items.title: Suspension & steering
items.body: Knocks over bumps, drifting, or a ride that feels loose? Suspension and steering work brings back a smooth, controlled drive.

items.title: Tyres & alignment
items.body: From a puncture repair to a new set, we keep you rolling, and we keep you aligned so your tyres wear evenly and last longer.

items.title: Servicing

services.not_offered_body: We don't offer bodywork, paintwork or welding. Call if you're not sure whether we can help with your car.
